# Commands manual worktrees and one-time Codex history transfer

The transfer kit's `restore_history.py` verifies archive hash and SQLite compatibility, refuses non-empty destinations, remaps Windows paths, preserves login files, resets imported runtime metadata to read-only/on-request, creates a backup, and rolls back failure. It passed 10 safety tests plus disposable reads/resumes. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
